behaviour_summary: Tenant/user-scoped notification substrate with preference-gated dispatch, notification_log, sent/suppressed/failed statuses, narrow categories, and secret-looking payload rejection.
usf_target: USF notification intent, message, delivery evidence, classification, and safe payload model.
notes: React model is narrower than the authorised USF classification/status model.

behaviour_summary: Implemented channels are email, webhook, and in_app/local sink; SMS and push appear only as future direction.
usf_target: USF channel governance with provider mode and allowed classifications.
notes: Do not infer live delivery readiness.

behaviour_summary: Recipient resolution is server-side; missing destination fails closed; address details are not written to notification_log.
usf_target: USF recipient identity/address_ref safety model.
notes: React lacks verified address and address status depth.

behaviour_summary: Per-user/tenant/channel/category enable flags with own-user scoped read/update and audit.
usf_target: USF notification preference and tenant-safe preference audit.
notes: React preferences are not explicit consent records.

behaviour_summary: Disabled preference suppresses dispatch and writes suppressed evidence.
usf_target: USF suppression model and fail-closed suppression evidence.
notes: No separate suppression list/reason/bounce/complaint/do-not-contact model in React.

behaviour_summary: Notification transport config is typed, env-driven, local-first, timeout/retry bounded, and keeps webhook secret metadata separate.
usf_target: USF NotificationProvider config through secret references and provider modes.
notes: USF uses secret_ref control-plane references rather than raw env credential exposure.

behaviour_summary: Tenant email sender control plane supports disabled/local/smtp/brevo, redacted settings, write-only credentials, readiness classification, and audited test send.
usf_target: USF provider abstraction, sender identity, and secret_ref-only credentials.
notes: Local SMTP/Mailpit evidence does not prove production/live readiness.

behaviour_summary: Webhook worker claims due rows, records results, retries with backoff, and dead-letters after bounded attempts.
usf_target: USF delivery jobs, operational job integration, retry, and dead-letter evidence.
notes: React queue schema is lineage only, not a USF path/schema model.

behaviour_summary: Bounded retry/timeout exists across notification transports, SMTP adapter, health checks, and webhook worker backoff.
usf_target: USF bounded retry and value-free failure evidence.
notes: Retry is stronger in durable webhook delivery than sync notification dispatch.

behaviour_summary: Webhook row id is stable event/idempotency key; redrive of dead deliveries is idempotent.
usf_target: USF notification+channel+recipient+template idempotency key and dedupe evidence.
notes: General duplicate notification submission dedupe was not proven in React.

behaviour_summary: Audit covers preference changes, test sends, email sender changes/tests, webhook changes/tests/redrive, and dispatch markers.
usf_target: USF notification lifecycle audit and audit-of-notification-access.
notes: USF expands lifecycle event set.

behaviour_summary: Secret-looking notification payload keys are rejected; settings/audit omit secrets; webhook secrets are reveal-once.
usf_target: USF minimisation, classified payload redaction, and secret-looking value rejection.
notes: USF adds classification-aware rendered-payload policy.

behaviour_summary: Email delivery abstractions include EmailPort, noop/local ports, SMTP adapter, Mailpit proof, and failure classification.
usf_target: USF in-memory/local-test provider and safe delivery response model.
notes: Do not carry forward live SMTP/Brevo readiness claims.

behaviour_summary: Unit, substrate, package, and UI tests cover preferences, suppression, secret rejection, bounded retry, webhook delivery/redrive, email sender config, alert bridge, announcements, and safe UI behaviours.
usf_target: USF foundation tests rewritten from behaviour, excluding UI/Playwright implementation.
notes: UI tests are behaviour evidence only; no UI is ported.

react_proofs: 17 notification/webhook/email/alert/support runtime proof scripts or evidence records, 10 registered proof commands
behaviour_summary: Runtime proofs cover preferences, dispatch, transport routes, local email/webhook transport, email sender, webhook CRUD/worker/redrive, alert bridge, and announcements.
usf_target: USF notify-proof and validator evidence.
notes: Fresh USF proof is required and implemented in this branch.

behaviour_summary: No foundation notification template model found; Brevo docs state it does not own template management.
usf_target: USF typed, versioned, immutable notification template model.
notes: USF implements the required controlled template model rather than copying React.

behaviour_summary: No explicit marketing/bulk consent model; preferences are enable flags, not consent records.
usf_target: USF consent_status and marketing/bulk fail-closed policy.
notes: Do not infer consent from React preferences.

behaviour_summary: No unsubscribe model or unsubscribe feedback handling found.
usf_target: USF unsubscribe_status and suppression integration.
notes: Preference disable is not full unsubscribe governance.

behaviour_summary: Bounce handling appears as out-of-scope/follow-up; no implemented bounce feedback or suppression flow found.
usf_target: USF delivery.bounced evidence and bounce suppression posture.
notes: Deferred deliverability/privacy control.

behaviour_summary: Complaint handling appears as out-of-scope/follow-up; no implemented complaint feedback or suppression flow found.
usf_target: USF delivery.complaint.received evidence and complaint suppression posture.
notes: Do not claim deliverability governance from React evidence.

behaviour_summary: Matrix language references email/in-app/push/SMS, but implemented substrate proves email, webhook, and local in_app preference channel.
usf_target: USF explicit channel support and deferred unsupported channel posture.
notes: SMS, push, and real in-app inbox are absent/deferred runtime behaviours.

behaviour_summary: Composed notification providers such as Novu/Knock/Courier and production SMTP/Brevo readiness are deferred/not delivered.
usf_target: USF provider modes including live-external-deferred without production readiness claim.
notes: Critical boundary: no live external provider readiness claim.

behaviour_summary: Cross-domain senders use notification substrate for alert notifications and support announcements.
usf_target: USF notification intent from workflow/system events, bulk posture, and idempotent delivery jobs.
notes: Announcements are bulk-like but lack mature campaign controls.

behaviour_summary: Lifecycle evidence indicates an older notification runtime artifact was removed/deprecated.
usf_target: USF source-use disposition only.
notes: Do not resurrect removed React runtime shape.
